caption: The drawing shows a rectangular textile or quilt design with a repeating pattern of stylized flowers on a light beige or off-white background. Each flower has a red blossom with varying internal geometric patchworks of red and lighter red or orange, and the blossoms are attached to green stems with two green leaves. The flowers are arranged in offset horizontal rows, and each stem grows diagonally. The outer edge of the textile is bordered by a wide red ribbon-like motif that curves and forms bows at each corner and between them, decorated with contrasting dashed or dotted lines and filled with small star-like shapes. The overall color scheme consists primarily of red, green, and beige tones. The design is symmetrical and evenly spaced, giving the piece a uniform composition.
title: Appliqued Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
